Name: A Good Place BE

Dazero_Records.name: A Good Place BE
Dazero_Records.description:
A high-quality Bedrock port of the popular Java Fabric mod A Good Place. When you place a block, it smoothly scales up from a small size with a satisfying pop and slight translation toward the player.

Features

• 228+ full-cube blocks supported (stones, ores, deepslate variants, all planks, stripped woods/hyphae, all 16 wools, concretes, terracottas, bricks, mud, nether blocks, metal blocks, and more)

• Special jelly/squish effect for slime_block and honey_block

• Pure vanilla textures only – no custom PNGs

• Smooth scale + translation animation

• Works in Creative and Survival

Achievements Friendly!
Ever wanted to place torches straight from your offhand? Advanced Dynamic Lighting isn't just a basic dynamic lighting mod, it's a massive upgrade. It’ll never block or mess with whatever block you're holding in your main hand.

Name: DoubleHands - Functional Offhand like Java edition (MCPE PC etc)

Dazero_Records.name: DoubleHands - Functional Offhand like Java edition (MCPE PC etc)
Dazero_Records.description:
DoubleHands is a revolutionary :) Minecraft Bedrock addon designed to bring Java Edition offhand parity to your world. If you've ever wondered how to use a torch in your offhand on Bedrock or wanted to place blocks while holding a tool, this is the solution. Unlike basic cosmetic mods, this functional offhand addon allows you to hold and use items in your left hand exactly like the Java Edition. (This paragraph was mostly just for google search visibility, don't worry bout that lol)

This addon is compatible with Minecraft Bedrock 1.21+ (currently updated for latest 26.45), it works without any issues on Realms, Dedicated Servers (BDS), and single-player worlds and all of them have proper activation methods. Whether you need a amod for combat or offhand for mining, DoubleHands provides a almost-java for all bugrock, i mean bedrock players.

Name: Jujutsu awakening Add-On

Dazero_Records.name: Jujutsu awakening Add-On
Dazero_Records.description: ujutsu Awakening Addon features the Limitless Technique/Gojo abilities from the renowned anime Jujutsu Kaisen. For now, it exclusively showcases the abilities of the modern era’s most formidable sorcerer, Gojo Satoru, including his distinctive combat style. Drawing inspiration from the popular Java mod Epic Fight, this addon aims to emulate M1 combat mechanics. Your journey begins with a combat style modeled after Gojo Satoru, with each weapon or combat style accompanied by additional abilities. These abilities require specific inputs, such as Sneak+Click or Jump+Click, to unleash their full potential.

Name: Verity - Bedrock Edition

Dazero_Records.name: Verity - Bedrock Edition
Dazero_Records.description:
If he's on the ground, you can chat with him, but if he's in your inventory, wake him up by chatting "Hey Verity". Don't go too far because Verity can't hear you.

Absolutely do not invite another friend if you have been in Verity's world for two days; he doesn't like that.

You can ask him anything because he knows everything (mathematics, ore locations, animal sounds, any sound at all, you can even ask him to play a song if you're bored, etc.).

Absolutely do not make him angry.

He cannot die.

 What This Addon Does
✔️ Enables the offhand slot for more items

✔️ Mobile-friendly controls
✔️ Lightweight & no lag

Hello friends!
I’m super excited to finally share One Block with you all. This map is a result of over 8 months of hard work, testing, and love for Minecraft. I’ve tried to bring the full Java Edition experience into Bedrock with smooth mechanics, detailed phases, and a polished One Block journey.

You start with just one magical block in the sky, and as you break it, the world slowly unfolds beneath your feet. But that’s just the beginning! The map features 16 unique levels — each themed around biomes, caves, dimensions, and more. Expect surprises, challenges, mobs, and mystery in every phase. Perfect for solo players and even better with friends!

I’ve spent countless hours making sure every detail feels just right — from mob spawns to phase transitions. If you enjoy the map, please share it with your friends and subscribe to my YouTube channel: DtA MC to support my work and future projects.
